title: Recover green master provenance after unauthorized direct push
acceptance_criteria: Document autonomous recovery procedure for a direct-master-push incident
Current master state is revalidated through the single integration PR
Task reaches MERGED_VERIFIED with PR/head/merge/post-merge evidence
validation_commands: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
notes: Triggered because direct master pushes after PR #33 caused provenance failures; CI #254 explicitly failed master-merge-audit while fabric/KREATE/repository checks passed.
PR #34 is the single integration PR. Its head was merged with latest master state through branch merge commit 71f84322faa6bbb650bd3a2ad7a108daad7cf90f after master advanced again during recovery.
This task is autonomous; the separate branch-protection administration task remains the only human gate.
